title: Clo Enterprise Workshop Sri Lanka 2024
description: Thank you Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 ! The CLO team had an amazing time with our Enterprise clients in Colombo during our 4-day workshop, where we hosted a series of in-depth discussions & learning sessions. Our Design and Implementation Specialists took the opportunity to share the latest features and capabilities of our eCLOsystem, while providing hands-on consultations and skill-up demos for our users. 🙏 Thanks to all of our clients who participated, and we look forward to the next one!
transcript: The seminar is really good for all the people who's working with 3D departments and also who's trying to involve with the 3Ds and we learn many things from Claw. The major difference is Claw giving a whole solution for the 3D garment not only for the 3D creation so they providing showroom high-quality animation and they have very advanced process to share our garment with customer. Claw 3D software allows us to see the sample cutting and also to see the sample nematomaceous. We can also see the sample in the form of a sample emissive. We do the swimwear for the customers who buy T52 M&S. We go to the UK as a color sample. It is a very important product for us. The workshop is well organized and very informative. We can also reduce the cost of 3D samples without using a photo sample. We can also reduce the cost of 3D samples without using a photo sample. In this workshop, we got many things inside animation path. I was very happy to be able to join in the workshop. We have received many Claw. By using the Claw 3D we can see Crabby, Crepeen, AI technology, animation in 3D. Thank you for giving us this kind of opportunity for increasing our knowledge and skill of workshop. The team is very friendly and easy to engage with us. markdown_content: ## Overview of Clo Enterprise Workshop Sri Lanka 2024 This section provides an overview of the Clo Enterprise Workshop held in Sri Lanka in 2024, highlighting its focus on 3D garment technology, including Clo 3D software capabilities, animation, and industry applications. The Clo Enterprise Workshop in Sri Lanka 2024 was highly beneficial for professionals working in 3D garment departments and those seeking to engage with 3D technologies. The workshop emphasized Clo's comprehensive solution for 3D garment development, which goes beyond just 3D creation to include showroom-quality animations and advanced sharing processes with customers. ## Clo 3D Software Capabilities and Applications This section explains the specific features and technical advantages of Clo 3D software, including sample visualization methods and its application in product development such as swimwear for major clients. Clo 3D software enables users to visualize garment samples through various detailed methods: sample cutting, sample nematomaceous (likely referring to fabric simulation or texture mapping), and sample emissive (emission or rendering effects). These visualization tools help in accurately assessing garment design before physical production. An example application includes the production of swimwear for customers purchasing T52 M&S products, with samples sent to the UK as color samples. This highlights Clo 3D’s role in international product development and quality assurance. ## Benefits of Using Clo 3D in Garment Production This section details the practical advantages of adopting Clo 3D technology in garment manufacturing, focusing on cost reduction and efficiency improvements. The workshop underscored several benefits of Clo 3D, including: - Significant reduction in manual effort, estimated to be at least halved. - Lower costs by minimizing the need for physical 3D samples and photo samples. - Enhanced efficiency in the product development cycle through improved visualization and iteration. These benefits contribute to streamlined workflows and cost-effective garment design processes. ## Animation and AI Technology Integration in Clo 3D This section covers the advanced animation capabilities and AI technology integration demonstrated during the workshop, expanding on how these features enhance 3D garment visualization. Participants were introduced to Clo 3D’s advanced animation paths, which allow dynamic and realistic garment movement simulation. The software also incorporates AI technologies that improve fabric behavior simulation and animation quality, enhancing the realism and usability of 3D models in presentations and virtual showrooms. ## Workshop Experience and Team Engagement This section summarizes participant feedback on the workshop organization, knowledge gained, and team interaction. The workshop was described as well-organized and informative, providing valuable learning opportunities even for experienced professionals. Attendees felt inspired to apply the new knowledge and skills in their work environments. The Clo team was noted for being friendly and easy to engage with, fostering an encouraging learning atmosphere. ## Summary The Clo Enterprise Workshop Sri Lanka 2024 effectively showcased Clo 3D’s comprehensive garment simulation and animation solutions, emphasizing practical benefits such as cost reduction, efficiency, and enhanced visualization. The integration of AI and animation technology in Clo 3D supports advanced garment design and presentation, making it a valuable tool for the apparel industry. The positive participant feedback highlights the workshop’s impact on skill development and industry engagement.
